project-hq.notes: Renamed from orchestrate-threads on 2026-09-11. Establishes one pinned project HQ as the user's sole interface for a durable task queue. HQ captures task dumps with stable IDs, priorities, dependencies, authority and one owner; it records dispatching before creation, reuses workstream owners, monitors evidence, and continues ready work until the queue is empty or human input is required. Durable tasks serve ongoing isolated work, subagents serve bounded work, and the user never carries briefs or messages between them. The compact docs/agents/hq.md ledger is medium-term operational memory; detailed reports remain with owners and confirmed reusable lessons belong in project docs. A single idempotent project-hq-daily-wake automation registers active HQ addresses and uses a cheap model to wake registered pinned HQs daily, while active work retains its shorter heartbeat. Tracker use remains per item and never follows from availability. Repository action and delivery authority remain explicit. GitHub Copilot HQ preserves its checkout and delegates repository mutation only to a verified separate worktree.

setup-ossian-stack.notes: Authored 2026-08-30, modelled on mattpocock's setup-matt-pocock-skills (explore, present, confirm, then write) and cursor's setup-pstack. Neither was vendored. This is post-install configuration: it verifies the invoking runtime first, migrates superseded plugins and hand-maintained skill symlinks, covers the hook-approval gate, checks per-project configuration, and classifies dependencies by real execution path (global, project-local, package runner, MCP, or bundled fallback) instead of bare-command presence. Tracker-only requests stay scoped to project tracker configuration; missing trackers are optional for general setup unless tracked delivery is chosen. Concise tracker reporting policy: meaningful events only, no unchanged blocker/HQ mirroring, minimal ownership and cross-runtime recovery records. Applied to all five tracker templates; project copies require a scoped merge preserving customizations. Existing Jira adoption starts with discovery: compare repository conventions with live project metadata, preserve the host scheme and recipes, and record each differing concept in issue-tracker.md. New shared Jira vocabulary or configuration requires explicit authorization. 2026-09-09: triage/to-spec/to-tickets/wayfinder were removed from the plugin, so the pickup loop, ticket brief, triage-label mapping, and jira-mapping overrides were deleted with them; what remains is plain tracker configuration plus the handoff-comment policy. Local audit (2026-09-05): focused description; task-specific reference routing. Preserve on refresh.

show-me.notes: humanlayer's show-me, SKILL.md verbatim. A visual presentation lens: pick the smallest view (pseudocode, call tree, component tree, file tree, mermaid, diff-shaped sketch, or one focused HTML file) that makes the current topic clear. It presents, it does not investigate, and it routes nowhere. Called in by how, teach, and commit-push-pr; for PR bodies only the text-native views apply, since a description renders mermaid and markdown but not an inline HTML file. simplify-code.notes: Authored 2026-08-29 from three inputs. The standard is Ossian's own 14 rules (skimmable code, minimal state space, discriminated unions, asserts over defensive fallbacks), supplied verbatim in conversation, that is the heart of the skill and has no upstream. Scope resolution, the behavior-preservation contract, and the verify step are structural borrows from EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin docs/guides/ce-simplify-code.md. Three cursor/plugins principle skills are folded in rather than vendored separately: principle-subtract-before-you-add (the subtract-then-collapse-then-polish ordering), principle-laziness-protocol (rules 15-17 and the maintainer-fatigue directive closing the standard), and the transferable half of principle-fix-root-causes (guards are symptom fixes; fix the pattern not the instance). principle-fix-root-causes is ALSO vendored whole as its own skill, since the rest of it is debugging guidance that does not belong here. The adversarial re-read loop encodes Ossian's practice of pushing a model past its first simplification; it dispatches two bundled reviewer personas (references/reviewers/) written here, following the persona-file pattern used by EveryInc's ce-code-review references/personas/ and by our own skill-creator agents/, rather than a host-specific agent registry. No file is reproduced from either source, so there is nothing to pin; re-read both if they change. Local audit (2026-09-05): focused description; conditional additional review. Preserve on refresh.

skill-cleaner.notes: Promoted from the internal checkout skill (2026-09-05). Explicit invocation only across paired metadata. Audits scoped skills and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md with article-derived, model-neutral review guidance. Optional dependency-free Node 22.6+ TypeScript analyzer retained to preserve the existing inventory, usage heuristics and Codex-style budget simulator; no Bun or package install. Without Node, the skill uses filesystem reads and reports unavailable numeric estimates. Scoped roots and no transcript reads are the defaults; global/log/config scopes are explicit. No automatic deletion or keyword-generated descriptions.
